title: Zhao Yun Stops a Boat on the River; Sun Quan and Cao Cao Face Each Other at Ruxu
summary: Lady Sun is recalled to Wu and takes Liu Bei's small son with her. Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei catch the boat mid-river, and Zhao Yun takes the child out of her arms — the second time he has carried Liu Shan out of somewhere.

At Ruxu, Cao Cao looks across the water at Sun Quan's fleet drawn up in perfect order and says the line that follows Sun Quan through history: 'To have a son one would wish for one like Sun Zhongmou.'
history: Both historical, and Cao Cao's remark is recorded — it was meant as praise and as a complaint about his own sons.

pins.note: Takes Liu Shan out of a boat, having once taken him out of an army.
'To have a son one would wish for one like Sun Zhongmou.'
